message.content:
I’m not connected to real‑time weather data, but here’s a quick snapshot of what you can generally expect in San Francisco:

| Season | Typical Temperature | Common Conditions |
|--------|---------------------|-------------------|
| Winter (Dec–Feb) | 48–58 °F (9–14 °C) | Cool, often cloudy, occasional fog, light rain |
| Spring (Mar–May) | 55–65 °F (13–18 °C) | Mild, less fog, occasional showers |
| Summer (Jun–Aug) | 57–68 °F (14–20 °C) | Warm, dry, but coastal fog can keep it cooler |
| Fall (Sep–Nov) | 58–68 °F (14–20 °C) | Pleasant, decreasing fog, occasional rain |

If you need the current forecast, you can check a reliable weather site (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, or the National Weather Service) or use a weather app on your phone. Let me know if you’d like a more detailed breakdown or help finding a specific source!
